comment: Calendar generated by dbt_date (date spine), it has no upstream model by design
Raw geolocation has many points per zip prefix and no key; int_zip_codes_located aggregates it to one row per prefix and tests that key
BigQuery's own job history (cost mart, D71): every deploy writes jobs to it, so it is always fresh when read
Review labels kept in the repo (D92): they change with a commit, not on a schedule, so there is no age to check
National holidays (#348): a year is loaded once and kept, so the table has no age to check; the coverage test assert_holidays_cover_every_year fails when a year is missing
Weather history (#349): the days of the orders are loaded once and kept, so the table has no age to check; the coverage test assert_weather_covers_every_order_day fails when a day is missing
The one place where orders meet customers (state, zip prefix): every order-grain mart reads it, fct_order_weather (#349) is one more
The one place where delivery lags and the late flag are defined: every mart that reports delivery reads it, fct_order_weather (#349) is one more
The order fact every order-grain mart converts or aggregates: dim_customers, cohorts, payments and fct_order_fx (#351, USD at the purchase-day rate) read it so the BRL amounts stay defined once
